m: 1. हू weak form of √ ह्वे, p. 1308.
2. हू mfn. calling, invoking (see इन्द्र-, देव-, पितृ-हू &c.)
3. हू ind. an exclamation of contempt, grief &c. (हू हू, the yelling of a jackal, VarBṛS.)
a: हू — ind. 1 An interjection of calling. --2 Of contempt. --3 Of pride. --4 Of grief (oh! ah! alas &c.).

m: हूंहूंकार-पार or हूंहूंकार-प्रिय, m. N. of Śiva, MBh.

m: हूण m. pl. N. of a barbarous people, the Huns (sg. = a king of the Huns), Inscr.; Buddh.; MBh. &c.
N. of a family, Cat.
of a people living in Bhārata-varṣa, MW.
a: हूणः(नः) — 1 A barbarian, foreigner; सद्यो मुंडितमत्तहूणचिबुकप्रस्पर्धि नारंगकम्. --2 A kind of golden coin, (probably current in the country of the Hūṇas). --णाः m. pl. N. of a country or its people; हूणादरोद्यनां R. 4. 68.

m: हूहू . See हुहु and 3. हू, p. 1301.
a: हूहू — m. A kind of Gandharva.

m: हूलुण्ट m. N. of a serpent-demon, Buddh.

m: हूम् ind. an exclamation or interjection &c.
See हुम्.
हूम्फ (of unknown meaning), Pañcad.

m: हून m. (often incorrectly for हूण) a kind of gold coin current in the kingdom of Mādra (commonly called a Pagoda and worth about 8 shillings), MW.
हूड् (cf. √ ह्रुड्, हुड्, होड् &c.) cl. 1. P. हूडति, to go, Dhātup. ix, 68.

हूर्छन n. going crookedly, crookedness, cunning, Dhātup.
हूर्छित or हूर्ण, mfn. (p.p.) gone crookedly Gr.
हूर्छितृ mfn. one who goes crookedly &c., ib.
हूर्णि m. or f. (fr. √ हृ ?) a small stream, channel, L.
हूर-हूण m. N. of a people, Vās., Introd.
हूर-लोप (?) m. a humming sound made for lulling children to sleep, Vās., Sch.

invocation &c.
